subject: Cloud buyflow commitment roadmap & billing questions
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdantcore.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, VerdantCore Procurement <procurement@verdantcore.com>
Cc: Samir Naqvi <samir.naqvi@awsmarketplace.amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud buyflow: commitment roadmap & billing questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency profile and the batching examples. We're beginning to build our internal MAP for a marketplace purchase (AWS private offer) and I wanted to clarify a few procurement/billing items before we formalize: 

- Do you have a canonical MAP template you use for marketplace private offers? We want to map evaluation milestones to payment/PO milestones.
- For AWS private offers, what is Redwood's preferred billing path post-acceptance: invoice from Redwood vs. AWS Marketplace invoice (and timing for each)?
- Any typical lead times for legal/procurement review and the DocuSign PO stage?

I'm attaching our internal approval window and a short checklist — happy to send the procurement team more detail. Our target is to close the private offer and have billing aligned by the end of May if possible.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Ops | VerdantCore
elaine.park@verdantcore.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: VerdantCore_approval_window.pdf (stub)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdantcore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud buyflow: commitment roadmap & billing questions

Hi Elaine — great to hear the demo resonated. Appreciate the goals and the end-of-May target; that should be achievable with a compact MAP and a few parallel tracks. I've attached a one-page MAP_v1.xlsx that outlines milestones, owners, and estimated lead times for each step. Key points here: 

- Evaluation / POC (2 weeks): dev access + sample traffic. Owner: Monica (CS).
- Procurement (private offer setup on AWS) (5–7 business days after PO): we can do "Invoice from Redwood" or AWS-billing via Private Offer. If you need AWS invoicing for single bill consolidation, we recommend choosing the AWS Marketplace invoicing path — Redwood will coordinate with Samir at AWS.
- Legal & Contract (standard SOW + PO): expect 3–5 business days if we use our private-offer template and minimal redlines. Rishi on copy for the actual SOW.
- Billing timing: If you accept an AWS private offer, AWS will invoice Net-30 to VerdantCore; if Redwood invoices directly, we can align Net-30 or custom terms as agreed in the PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30-minute alignment call tomorrow to lock milestones and sign owners.
2) We deliver MAP_v1 and the Redwood private-offer template (attached).
3) VerdantCore procurement confirms preferred billing path (AWS invoice vs Redwood invoice).

I copied Monica and Rishi to action the technical and legal pieces. I can also loop in our marketplace ops contact if you want direct AWS coordination.

Thanks — I can be on the call at 10am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (stub); VerdantCore_AWS_PrivateOffer_Template.pdf (stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdantcore.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud buyflow: commitment roadmap & billing questions

Hi Elaine — Monica from CS here, thanks for the context. For the evaluation lane I'll propose a compact plan that will feed the MAP spreadsheet: 

- Day 0: Access provisioned (IAM roles + ephemeral keys) — Redwood provides a scoped eval environment or we can enable access into your test account depending on preference.
- Day 1–7: Integration sprint (sample prompts, traffic shaping, latency checks). We usually run a lightweight load template and a 1k prompt eval set.
- Day 8–14: Quality regression check + token-cost tuning (batching & cache). Deliverable: pass/fail checklist + recommended runtime config for production.

Please let me know if you need a dedicated VPN or VPC peering for the eval — that affects lead time. I can get an engineer assigned for the integration sprint once we lock in the call.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdantcore.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud buyflow: commitment roadmap & billing questions

Elaine/Michael — a couple of legal/procurement notes to make the timeline frictionless: 

- We'll use the attached SOW-draft.docx with minimal modifications. If VerdantCore has standard clauses (data residency, audit rights), please highlight them in-line so we can incorporate quickly.
- For Marketplace private offers: we typically prepare both an AWS private-offer package (for Samir) and a Redwood invoice template. If VerdantCore prefers vendor consolidation via AWS, ensure procurement sends the legal PO to both Redwood and the AWS Marketplace contact to avoid billing split issues.
- DocuSign: we can generate the PO+SOW bundle for signature once the MAP milestones are agreed. Expect 24–48 hours for DocuSign circulation and completion if signatories are available.

If you want, I can prepare a redline-ready SOW and a short checklist of required procurement fields (billing address, tax ID, approver name).

–Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (stub)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@verdantcore.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Naqvi <samir.naqvi@awsmarketplace.amazon.com>, VerdantCore Procurement <procurement@verdantcore.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud buyflow: commitment roadmap & billing questions

Thanks all — this is helpful. VerdantCore confirms: (1) we'll pursue the AWS private offer with AWS invoicing consolidated to VerdantCore (Samir on cc to coordinate private-offer setup), and (2) please issue the SOW+PO via DocuSign once the MAP_v1 milestones are finalized.

Target close: 2027-05-28 for private-offer acceptance and initial invoice generation. Procurement has a required field checklist — I'll send that by EOD so Rishi can incorporate any special terms. Also copying our procurement lead for final PO details.

One quick billing question: can Redwood support an invoice split (50% initial deposit, 50% on go-live) if we require staged payments? If so, please document that in the MAP milestones so procurement can approve.

Elaine Park
Head of Platform Ops | VerdantCore
